readerCopy.body: It can be easier to defend someone else forcefully than to ask for the same protection when the need is personal. When Mars opposes Chiron, action and sensitivity face each other directly, allowing courage to appear clearly on behalf of others while assertion becomes more expensive around an old personal vulnerability. The difference is useful information about where direct action still carries a history of consequence. The imbalance becomes visible when all available force goes outward and the same need remains unaddressed closer to home.
